originality:cpt_5af7828f45.overlap: A plywood maker already advises treating every cut edge and joint with borate preservatives; Greenply instead builds treatment into the core because surface coatings fail after cutting.
originality:cpt_5af7828f45.difference: The tracer that lets a homeowner see untreated edges with a UV torch was not found in searched sources. The treatment itself is not new.
originality:cpt_5af7828f45.quote: recommends applying borate-based preservatives or termiticides to all surfaces, especially edges and joints

originality:cpt_b58a7644c8.overlap: A published patent application describes a colour-change kit with an applicator for detecting treated wood, and standards already define the boron and copper spot tests.
originality:cpt_b58a7644c8.difference: Only the target market (Indian homeowners) differs. The mechanism and kit form exist and may be covered by the patent.
originality:cpt_b58a7644c8.quote: a kit with a compartment containing a solution with a color change agent and an antioxidant

originality:cpt_4519b271dd.overlap: Board makers already sell long termite guarantees: Duroply lifetime since 2016, CenturyPly Club Prime 25 years and Total Cover 10 years.
originality:cpt_4519b271dd.difference: Covering workmanship and any brand sounds different, but a buyer can get similar protection by choosing a guaranteed brand at no extra fee. Unbranded boards, the main risk, are the ones a warrantor would refuse.
originality:cpt_4519b271dd.quote: Duroply offers to compensate the customer the value of the furniture or 3 times the cost of the defective goods, whichever is lower

originality:cpt_a38a414885.overlap: Termite shields and ant caps are a known building practice. Their main job is to make termite tubes visible, not to stop termites.
originality:cpt_a38a414885.difference: Using standoffs on built-in furniture was not found. The value claim must change from protection to early detection, which weakens it.
originality:cpt_a38a414885.quote: the primary benefit of termite shields is making it more likely that a pest control expert will be able to identify a termite infestation, not preventing an infestation in the first place

originality:cpt_53d7f7d4b8.overlap: Third-party home inspection agencies already exist and charge by area. Checklists already tell owners to approve material samples.
originality:cpt_53d7f7d4b8.difference: A visit timed to board delivery, before cutting, was not found as a named service; existing agencies may offer it on request.
originality:cpt_53d7f7d4b8.quote: third-party inspection agencies charge on the basis of the sq ft area of the house

originality:cpt_05bdb39295.overlap: The government's free BIS Care app already verifies a licence from its CM/L number, and officials use it to catch fake plywood marks.
originality:cpt_05bdb39295.difference: The photo trail and badge add record keeping only. A photo does not prove the board in the furniture is the board photographed.
originality:cpt_05bdb39295.quote: allows users to check the authenticity of products using the "Verify Licence Details" feature

originality:cpt_79ee1405e9.overlap: Termite baiting is sold in India (Rentokil, UPL) and is normally placed around buildings. Leading bait systems are restricted to licensed professionals.
originality:cpt_79ee1405e9.difference: Putting bait inside furniture was not found, but indoor efficacy is unproven and licensing rules would force a pest-control partner.
originality:cpt_79ee1405e9.quote: Sentricon is sold exclusively to licensed and certified professionals and is not available for sale to unlicensed homeowners
